description: Curated sanitized public node evidence from a read-only production capture. Selected original observations reproduce the real SQL replay-bracketing failure; this is not complete market-volume history. No import ranges, credentials, account data or receipt bodies.
notes: Every selected observation matches a returned replay sample by timestamp, kind, price, authenticated market and canonical block identity. Original quantities, IDs and types are preserved.
The wider sample at12:21:11Z is omitted because the original full-row capture ends12:20:24Z. The earlier genuine12:20:24Z observation already brackets the final sale.
Stored candles are original database rows, including their full recorded volume; no synthetic candles or filler observations are introduced.
Block rows contain original height, hash, parent hash and timestamp only. Full header JSON was not captured.
The final transaction has two genuine pending swaps in one pool; both Swap and Sync logs are preserved.
Includes the original PCS V2 swaps needed to authenticate the selected state-sample activity; curated pool scoring never relies on fabricated swap volume.
